subject: Next steps: SDK onboarding & auth options for BrightBank integration
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Kapoor <aisha.kapoor@brightbank.com>, Sam Chen <sam.chen@brightbank.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps: SDK onboarding & auth options for BrightBank integration

Hi Aisha / Sam — thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Recap (high level)
- Goal: integrate Redwood inference for customer support reranking + structured tool calling for ticket triage.
- R&I constraints: BrightBank requires short-lived credentials, audit logging, and optional SSO for admin console access.

Open technical topics we discussed
- Auth approach: API keys vs OAuth2/service accounts (you flagged rotation & audit as must-haves).
- SDKs: you prefer a Python SDK path for initial POC and Node for the web layer.
- Routing & variants: need simple routing by region and cost tier; interested in embeddings + reranker for relevance.
- Structured output/tool-calling: want to validate deterministic output for downstream systems.

Proposed immediate next steps (please confirm):
1) Engineering deep-dive (45m) — technical owners: Sam + Ben. Agenda: auth options + sample token flows, SDK bootstrap, routing config, embedding index sizing.
2) We share a short checklist and a one-pager on auth options (attached).
3) Provide a short sample (Python) showing service-account token exchange + example embed/rerank call.

Questions for you before the deep-dive
- Do you have an existing service-account model (GCP/Azure) you'd like us to align with, or do you prefer API key + short-lived JWTs issued by Redwood?
- Are there IP allowlists / VPC peering requirements we should include in the agenda?
- Any internal compliance doc (redacted) you can share about key rotation SLOs?

I copied Ben (integration lead) and Monica (CS) — Ben, can you come prepared with the sample token flow and the skeleton SDK onboarding steps? Monica, please include any customer success constraints we should honor.

I'll follow up with calendar invites once Aisha confirms availability.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood-auth-options-onepager.pdf, brightbank-integration-checklist.xlsx
From: Sam Chen <sam.chen@brightbank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Kapoor <aisha.kapoor@brightbank.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: SDK onboarding & auth options for BrightBank integration

Thanks Marissa, this looks great. A few answers from our side: 

- We use GCP service accounts for most internal automation, so leaning that direction makes sense. We also have a secrets rotation policy (30 days) and need key usage audit logs.
- No VPC peering initially — we prefer IP allowlists + private endpoints.
- For the POC, Sam (me) will be the technical owner; Aisha will handle procurement/timing.

Requests before the deep-dive: 
1) Can you include both a GCP service-account flow and a fallback API-key + short-lived JWT flow in the one-pager? We want to see tradeoffs.
2) Example of how Redwood issues short-lived tokens and what KMS integrations look like (our security team uses Cloud KMS).
3) Rough estimate of embedding storage size for ~10M docs (ballpark).

We are available for a deep-dive Thu 2/12 11:00–12:00 PST or Fri 2/13 09:30–10:15 PST. Preference Thu.

—Sam
Senior Platform Engineer, BrightBank
sam.chen@brightbank.com

Ben / Monica — forwarding Sam's requirements. Please see the asks above; actionable items for the deep-dive (Thu 2/12 11:00 PST):

Ben:
- Prepare two short flows (one-pager + sample code):
  * GCP service-account flow (token exchange, how Redwood verifies, example Cloud KMS integration for signing/rotation).
  * API-key + short-lived JWT fallback (how rotation is automated, TTLs, audit logging behavior).
- Bring a 5–7 slide slide-deck of the sample SDK bootstrap (Python): install, auth example, simple generate + embed + rerank flow.

Monica:
- Pull the standard onboarding checklist and add any customer success constraints (SLA expectations, contact matrix).
- Note any sales/legal items we should highlight to procurement (data residency, retention, SOC2 evidence).

Aisha / Sam — we'll treat the call as technical scoping; procurement can join if needed.

Thanks — I’ll send an invite for Thu 2/12 11:00 PST and attach the drafts.

—Marissa

Subject: Confirmed: Deep-dive Thu 2/12 reschedule -> Fri 2/13 09:30 PST + pre-read attached

Hi all — small scheduling snag, Sam suggested Friday morning; confirmed for Fri 2/13 09:30–10:15 PST. 

Agenda (30–45m):
- 5m: intro & goals
- 10m: auth options (Ben) — service-account flow + API-key fallback, rotation pattern, KMS notes
- 10m: SDK bootstrap (Ben) — Python sample, embed + rerank code sketch
- 10m: operational & compliance (Monica) — retention, audit logs, SOC2 evidence
- 5m: next steps & mutual action plan

Pre-read attached: brightbank-integration-checklist.xlsx, redwood-auth-options-onepager.pdf, arch-diagram-v1.png

Quick answers to Sam's asks from the one-pager (summary):
- GCP service-account flow: Redwood supports customer-managed service accounts (recommended). We can accept signed JWTs exchanged for short-lived Redwood tokens; Cloud KMS for key rotation is compatible.
- API-key + short-lived JWT fallback: supported, but requires more frequent rotation and carries higher blast radius — good as a temporary approach for POC only.
- Embedding sizing: rough estimate for 10M docs @ 1536-d vectors = ~61GB raw (plus index overhead; we’ll size for ~3–4x depending on index type). Ben will bring a more precise calc.

Logistics: I’ll attach the calendar invite and include Zoom + shared doc. Please let me know if you need procurement on the call.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—Marissa
